residual_concerns.title: Semantic validation differs between assurance attachment and generic persistence admission
residual_concerns.observed: attach_continuation semantically validates supplied new artifacts. inspect_candidate uses generic validate(child); the assurance schema leaves data as an object without assurance replay.
residual_concerns.inferred_risk: A directly assembled and consistently resealed continuation is not guaranteed assurance-semantic validation by generic persistence admission.
residual_concerns.counterevidence: The intended assurance attachment constructor does perform semantic validation; persistence remains Draft-only and provides no authority.
residual_concerns.classification: composition admission-consistency concern; not an established authorization bypass
residual_concerns.next_step: Compose schema-dispatched assurance semantic validation into existing admission and recovery paths without changing authority limits.

residual_concerns.title: Co-storage does not establish assurance-to-repository-candidate cross-binding
residual_concerns.observed: attach_continuation validates artifacts individually without comparing their manifest binding to the continuation inventory. Review bindings hash explicitly supplied manifests and context.
residual_concerns.inferred_risk: Consumers could mistake an attached assurance artifact for evidence about the persisted repository candidate when no such cross-binding was established.
residual_concerns.counterevidence: Assurance results bind their own plan and supplied candidate/context; core independently binds its inventory and checks repository drift. The roundtrip fixture intentionally demonstrates independent composition, not authenticated candidate equivalence.
residual_concerns.next_step: Define an explicit candidate/context mapping or classify attachments as unbound; do not infer equivalence from shared storage.

residual_concerns.title: Cooperative append-only construction is not hostile-reseal resistance
residual_concerns.observed: Assurance constructors copy and append events and replay chain checks. Storage preserves prior checkpoint bytes, but lineage checks do not enforce retention of every prior record in the successor or an externally trusted history head.
residual_concerns.inferred_risk: A consumer treating resealable hashes or local predecessor archives as authenticated immutable history would overstate the guarantee.
residual_concerns.counterevidence: The source explicitly disclaims hostile-reseal protection, checks event predecessor/order/retry linkage, and preserves historical checkpoints through the cooperative write path.
residual_concerns.classification: documented trust-boundary limitation and continuity-composition concern, not a newly demonstrated defect
residual_concerns.next_step: If append-only continuity is required, add explicit successor-history extension checks in existing components; retain the hostile-reseal disclaimer unless an authorized external trust anchor is separately established.

institutional_result.recommendation: Enhance the existing continuation coordinator to compose assurance semantic admission/recovery validation, explicit assurance-to-candidate/context binding or unbound labeling, and history-extension checks where continuity is required.
acceptance_criteria_for_future_authorize: Direct admission and recovery cannot treat a semantically invalid assurance recommendation as validated merely because its envelope is consistently resealed.
Attachments explicitly identify whether their assurance manifest/context maps to the persisted repository candidate.
Required history-continuity policy rejects successor truncation or replacement while retaining prior evidence.
Draft-only, unverified-identity, no-approval and no-activation boundaries remain unchanged.

execution_and_authority.analysis_method: Direct bounded source, test-source, git-diff and file-digest inspection.
limitations: No test result is claimed from inspected test source.
No actor authentication, trusted independence, eligibility truth or authorization is established.
No institutional reconciliation or adjudication has been performed.
The three residual composition concerns remain unclosed.
